newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Plastics to acquire U.S. firm.
newsitem.headline: Royal Plastics to acquire U.S. firm.

text.p: Royal Plastics Group Ltd said on Thursday that it had signed a letter of intent to buy all the issued and outstanding shares of Michigan-based Plastic Trends Inc.
The acquisition will allow Royal Plastics to offer its customers a more complete package of plastic fittings for municipal sewer and water pipes, said Vic De Zen, Royal Plastics' president.
"Our competitive position will be enhanced by providing our customers an efficient and reliable source for municipal piping systems," De Zen said.
Royal Plastics operates its pipe business from three manufacturing facilities in Ontario and British Columbia.
